implementationDetails.audioStrategy: One Web Audio AudioContext realizes the browser signal path: per-layer bus GainNodes (Piano A, Piano B) drain a single deterministic pure-DSP StageEngine, then feed an ordered per-layer effect chain (Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, shared Rotary when routed) and a shared master GainNode (Master Level) + DynamicsCompressor limiter into one destination. The effects are real DSP operating on PCM, so tests render stereo blocks and measure that every unit/type/bypass/routing changes the audio; the browser context is injectable so graph tests verify one context, one destination, and full cleanup without a device. Grand, Upright, and Electric are bundled, offline, redistributable multi-root/multi-velocity sample libraries generated deterministically (many root notes across E1..E7 plus three velocity layers, so uniform pitch-shifting of a single note is not audible) and rendered as committed WAV assets under public/samples; Clav, Digital, and Misc are honest live synthesis (per the piano spec sourceRules). Generated sample tables are truthfully declared as generated, never as field recordings.
